content: TokenConsumptionChart (warren-4dc9) should follow the same data-passing pattern as all other charts on RunAnalytics.tsx: pass 'data?.tokens.xxx ?? []' directly rather than wrapping in '{data ? <Component data={data.tokens.xxx} /> : null}'. The null-conditional + fallback pattern renders the chart in its empty state during loading, consistent with RunsOverTimeChart, FailureReasonChart, etc. (warren-af75 polish).

name: merge-watcher-pr-state
description: Merge watcher (warren-3bc6): src/runs/reap/pr-merge-watcher.ts is the post_reap lifecycle-bus subscriber that settles runs.pr_state/pr_merged_at via the boot-resolved Forge (merged/closed_unmerged/unparseable/not_found all stop; 60s→15min backoff, 7d budget). NULL pr_state reads as unknown, never not-merged. The Forge-native PR checker moved from src/plan-runs/pr-merge.ts to src/runs/pr-merge.ts; plan-runs merge-gate/in-flight import it from there. Boot re-adoption (RunsRepo.listWithUnresolvedPr, staggered one initial interval per watch) keeps restarts from orphaning polls. RunsRepo PR writes live in src/db/repos/runs-pr.ts (size-ratchet extraction).

name: landed-work-analytics
description: Landed-work semantics (warren-bd57): RunMetricsRow carries prState straight from the merge-watcher column; NULL means unknown and is excluded from mergedPrRate denominators (never a failure). New RunTotals/RunGroupBucket fields must be classified in PUBLIC_RUN_TOTALS_FIELDS / PUBLIC_RUN_GROUP_FIELDS (src/server/handlers/runs/analytics.ts) — public-projections.test.ts key-compares against those lists. Adding fields to run-metrics.ts pushes it past the 500-line check:size budget: split builders into a sibling module (run-metrics-breakdowns.ts) and re-export the types. Test row factories with many ?? defaults trip noExcessiveCognitiveComplexity at 16 — use an all-null ROW_DEFAULTS object plus spread instead.

name: directory-difficulty-join
description: Per-directory difficulty insight (warren-8f1b): join the tool_calls rollup's filePaths JSON column (already fileShape-extracted at write time — never re-parse payloads) to run outcomes + same-run path-error retry memory + countSteeringByRun steering counts. Every analytics bucket ships denominators and a confidence qualifier; runs without rollup rows are 'unknown', counted in totals.runsInWindow but excluded from per-directory denominators. New enum-shaped wire values go in src/core/wire.ts; wire.ts has a frozen line budget, so keep its doc comments tight.
